title: Qualification invalidation after independent exact-B1.10 authoritative qbot audit

reason.summary: The persisted direct-oracle gate did not independently execute exact B1.10 watstor()+fluxes() for authoritative qbot. It executed the common F-SI16 route and compared it with a persisted vector whose qbot had been reconstructed with the same continuity recurrence used by the common materializer.
gate_behavior: uses src/legacy/b1_10_port/headcalc.f90 and the common adapter rather than an independently reconstructed exact B1.10 execution
derives a runner-local response-capable TRIDAG from the F-SI04 stub rather than compiling the exact reconstructed B1.10 TRIDAG source
the persisted oracle provenance explicitly states qbot was reconstructed from the accepted HeadCalc state using the same water-continuity recurrence as the common F-SI16 result contract
therefore the PASS label did not prove independent identity to authoritative exact B1.10 fluxes() qbot

independent_strengthened_oracle_finding.fixture_scope: SWBOTB=5, inactive macropores, zero source/sink/root sink, explicit top flux, same accepted HeadCalc state
independent_strengthened_oracle_finding.cause: arithmetic-order mismatch: common mode-5 materializer accumulates storage node-by-node into qbot, whereas exact B1.10 watstor()+fluxes() first forms aggregate volact and volm1 using SUM(theta*dz), then applies (volact-volm1)/dt in qbot

required_repair.production_scope: materialize prescribed-head qbot with exact B1.10 watstor()+fluxes() arithmetic grouping using explicit request/state/provider data; do not call legacy fluxes() from the common solver
required_repair.oracle_scope: execute independently reconstructed exact B1.10 HeadCalc + watstor + fluxes and compare pressure head, water content, authoritative qbot and iteration route directly against the common route
required_repair.regressions: rerun focused F-SI16 matrix, F-SI15 pinned regression and F-KT boundary regression
